issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires that the helper routine set_pixel must not be exported ("Es darf nicht global exportiert werden (kein 'global' Keyword)"), but the solution file declares the symbol as global ("global set_pixel"). This contradicts the specification and may confuse students about the intended visibility of the routine (whether they must or must not add a 'global' directive). It also changes the linkage/visibility behavior compared to the template (which does not export set_pixel).
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the 'global set_pixel' directive from the solution so the function is not exported, matching the problem statement and the template. If exporting set_pixel was intentional for testing, instead update the problem statement to explicitly allow exporting and explain why; otherwise ensure the solution keeps set_pixel local (no 'global' keyword).
